tests: [cookies.test] Cookie specs Page.setCookie should set secure same-site cookies from a frame
reason: The test accepts the fixture's self-signed certificate with `acceptInsecureCerts`, which Chromium refuses per context, since its certificate override applies to the whole browser (as browsercontext-cookies-third-party's CO-052 does)

tests: [cookies.test] Cookie specs Page.setCookie should set secure same-site cookies from a frame
reason: The test reads the cross-site frame's `document.cookie` through the frame's isolated world, which stock WebKit doesn't have (`isolatedWorlds` is unsupported)

tests: [cookies.test] Cookie specs Page.setCookie should set a cookie with a partitionKey
[cookies.test] Cookie specs Page.deleteCookie should only delete cookie from the default partition if partitionkey is not specified
reason: Sets a partitioned cookie, which Firefox and stock WebKit can't do (`cookies.partitioned` is unsupported there, as Firefox doesn't say which partition a cookie is in). No matrix row names partitioned cookies, so this cites addCookies, the nearest row, which claims Strider has them

tests: [cookies.test] Cookie specs Page.deleteCookie should delete cookie with partition key if partition key is specified
reason: Removes a cookie in one partition by its partition key. Strider's `CookieJar.remove` takes a name, domain and path, with no partition key, and removes the cookie in every partition, so the test's partitioned removal can't be written. No matrix row names a partition option for removal; this cites clearCookies, the nearest row
